# Application Development Context

When this application URL is provided for maintenance or continued development:

1. Read /ai-context.json first.
2. Read the local docs referenced by ai-context.json.
3. Use docs/DATA_FLOW_MAP.md to trace visible values and user actions through client state, API/functions, services/repositories, storage, and external sources. Verify the current implementation before relying on stale or incomplete mapping.
4. Use the parent starter-template manifestUrl for shared development rules.
5. Preserve existing behavior, data compatibility, and responsibility boundaries.
6. Update local handoff docs in the same change when architecture, data contracts, data flows, UI constraints, or project status change.
7. Do not fill unknown data-flow details by inference; mark them unknown until verified from code, runtime, settings, or an authoritative external contract.
8. GitHub Actions are not the default automation mechanism.
